**Finding: Compliant** (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.

- **§14.16 Freedom of Action** is mutual and affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to contract with others; it does not bind us.
- No non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use covenant appears anywhere: targeted searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "shall not", and develop/engage-in/restrict language returned only warranty disclaimers, licence-scope terms, and jurisdiction boilerplate.
- The only Customer-side restraints are **§14.11 (no resale)** and **§12.1 (Base Components licensed solely in connection with the Services; no reverse engineering)** — ordinary scope-of-use and licence limits, not restrictions on the businesses we may run or the products we may buy or build.
- **§14.19 Geographic Scope** limits IBM's delivery territory, not our activities, so it benefits/binds the vendor side.
